profile.name: Architectural Design Studio
profile.title: Architectural BIM & CAD Specialist
profile.intro: I provide remote architectural BIM, CAD and construction documentation support to US design firms, builders and developers — working from your drawings, CAD files, sketches, point clouds and site information to produce coordinated, submission-ready documents.
profile.bio:
I have worked in architectural documentation since 2018, across residential and commercial projects: permit sets, full construction documents, structural and MEP coordination, and scan-to-BIM conversions of existing buildings.
Most of my work begins with someone else's material — a marked-up PDF, a legacy CAD file, a set of site photographs, a registered point cloud — and ends with a coordinated set that a plan checker or a builder can work from. That means reading drawings carefully, asking the questions that matter before modelling starts, and keeping the model and the sheets in step so a change in one shows up in the other.
I work remotely and overlap US business hours, so review comments raised during your day are answered by the next morning.

toolNotes.Revit: Architectural, structural and MEP modelling, families, sheets and schedules
toolNotes.SketchUp: Massing, site context and presentation modelling

process.title: Brief and files
process.text: You send drawings, CAD files, sketches, scans or photographs, and tell me what the deliverable has to be.

process.title: Scope and questions
process.text: I read the material, come back with the questions that matter, and confirm scope, format and standards before modelling starts.

process.title: Modelling and drafting
process.text: Work proceeds against your standards — title block, layers, view templates — with progress files shared for review.

process.title: Review and revisions
process.text: You mark up, I revise. Comments raised in your working day are answered by the next morning.

process.title: Delivery
process.text: Coordinated set delivered as PDF, DWG, RVT or the format your team works in.
